title: Cardinal Müller denounces ‘neo-socialist wokism of our times’
description: Bringing you the news from a traditional Catholic perspective. ( LifeSiteNews ) — Cardinal Gerhard Müller recently denounced “neo-socialist wokism” and warned against efforts to reduce the Catholic Church to a mere “humanitarian organization,” according to a detailed report based on a transcript of his remarks published by AdVaticanum . … He has repeatedly linked such trends to “woke ideology.” In an November 2024 essay he accused synodal factions of seeking to make Catholic teaching compatible with a “neo-gnostic woke ideology” and of subordinating the Church to worldly projects such as Agenda 2030. In October, he stated there is “no place for rainbow flags in the Church” and criticized the German Synodal Way for focusing on “this modern ideology of wokism” rather than Christ. Earlier, in 2023, he described the German Synodal Way as “worse than schism” because it has abandoned “the very essence of Christianity” for a “materialistic and nihilistic woke culture,” and he stated plainly last year, “We cannot be a good Catholic and be a Communist … or accept the Woke Ideology.”
